meaning: Status of this file: schema only. Bite 1 of the v0.2 protocol is not complete. Official boundaries, the common time interval, hydrologic-year definition, missing-data rules, uncertainty, and retrieved source versions remain unfilled.
formula_or_rule: See Release/Examples/central-valley/freshwater_data_dictionary_v0.2.NOTES.md. This filename is the protocol §12 deliverable name; presence of this file is not completion of Bite 1.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Not a registry symbol.

meaning: Recoverable groundwater storage estimate
formula_or_rule: Use observed or model-assimilated storage. A cumulative storage-loss estimate alone is not an absolute recoverable stock (crosswalk).
required_separations: Do not use bare G. Do not identify G_W with representational substrate G_i. Storage-loss tables in the v0.1 example are change/loss relative to a historical reference, not absolute recoverable stock.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: bare G -> G_W for recoverable groundwater stock; G_i remains representational substrate.

meaning: Representative groundwater head
formula_or_rule: Domain-scoped symbol. Declare which wells or head surface represent the unit of analysis.
required_separations: Head decline is distinct from stock loss and from permanent capacity loss (protocol §6). Do not use bare H.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: H -> domain-scoped H_W.

meaning: Gross groundwater withdrawal
formula_or_rule: Keep gross pumping separate from net storage change. If inferred: hat W_g = hat R_n + hat R_m + hat Q_net - hat dG_W/dt (crosswalk).
required_separations: Gross withdrawal is not net depletion. Do not hide Q_net in a pumping residual without evidence it is negligible or separately accounted for.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk physical balance identity.

meaning: Natural aquifer recharge
formula_or_rule: Keep natural recharge separate from managed recharge.
required_separations: Recharge is not synonymous with sustainable yield, because pumping can reduce groundwater discharge to streams, wetlands, springs, and dependent ecosystems (protocol §4).
source_name: Candidate class from protocol §13: USGS Central Valley groundwater, subsidence, InSAR, GPS, extensometer, and model products (version and retrieval date unfilled); Candidate class from protocol §13: California DWR SGMA Data Viewer, basin water budgets, Bulletin 118, and groundwater-condition updates (version and retrieval date unfilled)

meaning: Managed recharge retained in basin
formula_or_rule: Count only the increment retained after downstream rights, environmental flows, evaporation, treatment loss, and climate covariance are considered (protocol §8, when used as new water).
required_separations: Separate from R_n. Catchment capture is not new water at basin scale unless the counterfactual destination is specified (protocol §8).

meaning: Surface-water delivery or diversion
required_separations: Keep separate from groundwater withdrawal and from net connected-water / lateral flows Q_net.
source_name: Candidate class from protocol §13: USGS Central Valley groundwater, subsidence, InSAR, GPS, extensometer, and model products (version and retrieval date unfilled); Candidate class from protocol §13: California DWR SGMA Data Viewer, basin water budgets, Bulletin 118, and groundwater-condition updates (version and retrieval date unfilled)

meaning: Demand or delivered water service
formula_or_rule: Used in the buffer-financed stability interval with a declared epsilon_D_W (protocol §5). Do not treat service stability as proof of viability.
required_separations: Do not use bare D. Delivered service is not the same as stock viability.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: D -> domain-scoped D_W.

meaning: Cumulative land subsidence
required_separations: Subsidence is not identical to irreversible storage-capacity loss C_irr, though they may be related; assess overlap before later weighting (protocol §6).
source_name: Candidate class from protocol §13: USGS Central Valley groundwater, subsidence, InSAR, GPS, extensometer, and model products (version and retrieval date unfilled)

meaning: Irreversible compaction or storage-capacity loss
formula_or_rule: Used in the Temporal Mining signature as dC_irr/dt > 0 over a declared window (protocol §5).
required_separations: Permanent capacity loss is distinct from recoverable stock loss and from head decline (protocol §6).
source_name: Candidate class from protocol §13: USGS Central Valley groundwater, subsidence, InSAR, GPS, extensometer, and model products (version and retrieval date unfilled)

meaning: Burden transferred to connected surface water/ecosystems
preferred_unit: declared measure (must be stated when filled; not pre-selected here)
formula_or_rule: The protocol leaves the measure to be declared. This row requires a declaration before use; no measure is chosen in this dictionary.
required_separations: Keep resource/energy transport separate from burden transfer (crosswalk Transport distinction; definition decisions 16 October 2026).
registry_or_crosswalk_note: No new primitive. Measure remains application-declared.

meaning: Firm substitute capacity under the test scenario
formula_or_rule: Only existing capacity (operating, metered, and available in the test year) enters current Q_alt,firm(t). Contracted capacity may enter a dated scenario. Planned and aspirational capacity cannot close the current transition gap (protocol §8).
required_separations: Do not use the example's earlier S_alt,firm label. Do not count planned or aspirational projects as current firm capacity.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: S_alt,firm -> Q_alt,firm.
status: schema-only; source unfilled; project classification is Bite 4

meaning: Signed lateral and connected-water exchanges not already counted in recharge or withdrawal
formula_or_rule: dG_W/dt = R_n + R_m - W_g + Q_net, with non-overlapping flow definitions and common boundary/time support (protocol §6.1; crosswalk).
required_separations: Must be declared rather than hidden in a pumping residual. Omitting Q_net requires evidence that it is negligible or separately accounted for.

meaning: Declared reference storage for raw stock burden B_G,W = [G_ref - G_W]_+
formula_or_rule: Must be declared before any B_G,W is computed. Not selected in this dictionary. A preferred target is not a failure boundary (START_HERE; definition decisions 16 October 2026).
required_separations: G_ref is not G_min and not V_max or V_PCB.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Do not compute burdens in Bite 1.

meaning: Declared reference head for B_H,W = [H_ref - H_W]_+
formula_or_rule: Must be declared before any B_H,W is computed. Not selected in this dictionary.
required_separations: H_ref is a domain-scoped reference, not a universal viability boundary.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Do not compute burdens in Bite 1.

meaning: Declared usable-stock floor used only in the net-depletion timescale
formula_or_rule: For G_W > G_min and -dG_W/dt > 0, local net-depletion estimate is (G_W - G_min)/(-dG_W/dt). It is not a forecast when rates change (protocol §6.1; crosswalk).
required_separations: A cumulative storage-loss estimate alone supplies neither the absolute recoverable stock nor its operational floor (crosswalk).
parent_section: protocol §6.1; crosswalk; definition decisions 16 October 2026 (Temporal Mining row)
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Floor must be declared; not selected here.
status: schema-only; floor unfilled; required before any net-depletion time is computed

meaning: Groundwater age (residence-time distribution); spatial, depth- and path-dependent
preferred_unit: time (distribution, not a single year claimed for all extracted water)
formula_or_rule: Do not assert that all extracted water is thousands or tens of thousands of years old (protocol §7). The core result should survive without an age estimate.
required_separations: Age is not recharge rate and not storage renewal. Crosswalk: do not use age for tau_s.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: groundwater age used for tau_s is corrected; age is tau_age; infer renewal/recovery tau_s using a separate physical model.
status: second-stage; not required for Bite 1 completeness of core series

meaning: Renewal or recovery timescale from a separate physical model, not from age
formula_or_rule: Define rho_TM = tau_s / tau_d only after estimating both comparable timescales and their uncertainty. No universal cutoff is assumed (protocol §6.1).
required_separations: Not tau_age. Not tau_draw.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Registry v0.3.2 also registers rate-form renewal coverage when timescales are undefined (mussel decision record). That mapping is not imported as a required Central Valley field here; application quantities do not become universal primitives by appearing in an example.

meaning: Gross draw time G_W / W_g when W_g > 0
formula_or_rule: tau_draw = G_W / W_g only as gross draw time when W_g > 0 (protocol §6.1).
required_separations: Not time to exhaustion. Not net depletion time.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: G/W_g called time to exhaustion -> tau_draw, a gross draw timescale.
status: schema-only; do not compute until G_W and W_g are filled

meaning: Local net-depletion estimate (G_W - G_min) / (-dG_W/dt) when G_W > G_min and -dG_W/dt > 0
formula_or_rule: Local linear approximation, not a forecast under changing recharge or pumping (crosswalk).
required_separations: Requires usable stock above a declared floor and net loss after recharge and other flows. Distinct from tau_draw and from tau_age.
status: schema-only; do not compute until G_W, G_min, and dG_W/dt are filled

meaning: rho_TM = tau_s / tau_d after both comparable timescales and uncertainty are estimated
formula_or_rule: No universal cutoff is assumed (protocol §6.1). Do not select a cutoff in this dictionary.
required_separations: Distinguish from a reachability proxy (crosswalk). Not an HKL score.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: v0.3.1 symbol. Do not compute in Bite 1.

meaning: Primary Temporal Mining storage-change diagnostic: max(0, -dG_W/dt)
formula_or_rule: TM_G(t) = [-dG_W(t)/dt]_+ (protocol §5). Requires a declared window before the signature test in Bite 3.
required_separations: This diagnostic is not validation of Causal Ethics, HKL, Delta-Self, or AEF (protocol §1).
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Application diagnostic, not a new universal primitive.
status: schema-only; do not compute until dG_W/dt is filled; signature test is Bite 3

meaning: W_g(t) / (R_n(t) + R_m(t))
formula_or_rule: Report only with a positive denominator and common boundary/time support. Cannot establish sustainability alone. Omits lateral flows, discharge capture, storage changes, ecological requirements, water quality, and estimation uncertainty (protocol §5).
required_separations: Not a viability result and not ACR.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Application ratio, not a new universal primitive.
status: schema-only; optional; not a sustainability finding

meaning: Declared critical demand or service used in T_gap(t) = [D_W,crit(t) - Q_alt,firm(t)]_+
formula_or_rule: Must be declared before any transition-gap calculation. Not selected here. Transition-gap audit is Bite 4.
required_separations: Do not use bare D_critical. Distinct from observed D_W.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Crosswalk: D_critical -> D_W,crit.

meaning: Transition-gap: max(0, D_W,crit(t) - Q_alt,firm(t))
formula_or_rule: Protocol §5. Current gap uses only existing firm capacity (§8).
required_separations: Planned or aspirational capacity cannot close the current gap.
status: Bite 4; listed so the dictionary does not lose the symbol

meaning: Selected Central Valley hydrologic boundary for the common analysis
preferred_unit: official boundary identifier and description (to be cited)
formula_or_rule: Protocol §12 Bite 1: select Central Valley and nested San Joaquin boundaries. §3 unit of analysis is basin or subbasin-year for the hydrologic unit. Do not merge hydrologic, institutional, and built-environment units into one score (protocol §3).
required_separations: Hydrologic unit remains distinct from institutional and built-environment units.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: A case-selection decision, not a new primitive.
status: UNFILLED-REQUIRED; not claimed complete in this proposal

meaning: Nested San Joaquin Valley high-subsidence test boundary
preferred_unit: official boundary identifier and description (to be cited)
formula_or_rule: Protocol §2: the San Joaquin Valley supplies the nested high-subsidence test.
required_separations: Nested inside, not substituted for, the Central Valley boundary.
status: UNFILLED-REQUIRED; not claimed complete in this proposal

meaning: Fixed common time interval for aligned series
preferred_unit: start and end dates, with hydrologic-year definition
formula_or_rule: Protocol §12 Bite 1: fix the common time interval; define hydrologic year, units, missing-data rules, and uncertainty.
status: UNFILLED-REQUIRED; not claimed complete in this proposal

meaning: Later weighted sum of normalized burden channels; not computed in Bite 1
preferred_unit: declared normalized units, if and when computed
formula_or_rule: Protocol §6 and §12 Bite 5: pre-register normalization, weights, thresholds, and held-out periods before constructing V_W. Report unaggregated components beside V_W. Call the result Lyapunov-style unless the claimed Lyapunov conditions are established. Protocol §14: do not begin by choosing HKL weights.
required_separations: V_W is not V*, V_PCB, or V_max. Coverage or a declining index is not a complete viability or ethical judgment.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Reserved name only. No weights or normalizations are selected here.

meaning: Observed or model-assimilated net storage change, kept as its own series and not identified with a pumping residual
formula_or_rule: Protocol §4 requires keeping net storage change separate from gross pumping and from recharge. Protocol §5 uses observed or model-assimilated storage change as the primary measure for TM_G. If a balance residual is also computed, record it separately from this series.
required_separations: Separate from W_g, R_n, R_m, Q_net, and from any inferred pumping residual. Not automatically equal to a computed R_n+R_m-W_g+Q_net unless that equality is shown.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Application series, not a new registry primitive.

meaning: Streamflow capture (pumping-induced reduction of groundwater discharge to streams or other surface-water features), kept separate from other flows
formula_or_rule: Protocol §4: keep streamflow capture separate. Protocol §4 also notes that recharge is not synonymous with sustainable yield because pumping can reduce groundwater discharge to streams, wetlands, springs, and dependent ecosystems. This row is not automatically identical to Q_net or E_sw.
required_separations: Separate from R_n, R_m, W_g, Q_sw, Q_net, and E_sw unless an explicit, exclusive mapping is later declared and justified.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Application series, not a new registry primitive.

meaning: Depletion timescale used as the denominator of rho_TM = tau_s / tau_d, only after both comparable timescales and their uncertainty are estimated
formula_or_rule: Protocol §6.1. tau_d is not automatically tau_d_net. The crosswalk's tau_d_net = (G_W - G_min)/(-dG_W/dt) is a local linear approximation, not a forecast. Using tau_d_net as tau_d requires an explicit declaration that the two are being identified for a stated analysis.
required_separations: Distinct from tau_draw, tau_age, tau_s, and from tau_d_net unless that identification is declared.

meaning: Declared tolerance on change in delivered service in the buffer-financed stability interval of protocol §5
preferred_unit: same units as dD_W/dt, once declared
formula_or_rule: Protocol §5: |dD_W/dt| <= epsilon_D_W, together with dG_W/dt < 0 and dC_irr/dt > 0, over a declared window. Not selected in this dictionary. Signature test is Bite 3.
required_separations: Not a viability boundary and not V_max.
registry_or_crosswalk_note: Application threshold, not a new registry primitive.
status: deferred-until-later-bite; added as residual from CH-...-01-scope-residue

meaning: Climate covariates to be aligned with the core series, as listed in the minimum dataset
formula_or_rule: Protocol §11 item 5: surface-water deliveries and climate covariates. Specific covariate list is not chosen here.
required_separations: Covariates are not delivered service and not recharge.
